mapper.select: SELECT PHRASE_SQ, SIT_IDX, SRC_LANG, TXT_KO, TXT_EN, TXT_VI, TXT_JA, TXT_ZH, TXT_TH FROM TB_EEP_TRAVEL_PHRASE_M ORDER BY PHRASE_SQ
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_EEP_TRAVEL_PHRASE_M (SIT_IDX, SRC_LANG, TXT_KO, TXT_EN, TXT_VI, TXT_JA, TXT_ZH, TXT_TH, REG_IP, REG_DT) VALUES (#{SIT_IDX}, #{SRC_LANG}, #{TXT_KO}, #{TXT_EN}, #{TXT_VI}, #{TXT_JA}, #{TXT_ZH}, #{TXT_TH}, #{REG_IP}, NOW())
INSERT IGNORE INTO TB_EEP_TRAVEL_HIDE_M (PHRASE_KEY, HIDE_IP, HIDE_DT) VALUES (#{PHRASE_KEY}, #{HIDE_IP}, NOW())
